title: La Cornue — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for La Cornue.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "The Finest Cookware." Luxury tier. La Cornue is the pinnacle of range manufacturing — each unit handcrafted in Fayence, France with 6-8 week lead times. The CornuFe 110 and Chateau lines are available in 24+ exterior colors. Starting at $10,000, La Cornue is a status symbol in the worlds finest kitchens.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury statement kitchens. Customers for whom price is irrelevant and craftsmanship is everything.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for La Cornue:

• Handcrafted in Fayence, France — each unit is a work of art

• 24+ exterior colors — the most customizable luxury range

• 6-8 week lead time because each one is built to your order

• The range found in Michelin-starred restaurant owners homes

• Starting at $10K+ — the ultimate kitchen status symbol
